FOREWORD

This Indian Standard (Second Revision) which is identical with ISO 8147: 1995 `Shipbuilding and marine structures -- Derrick rigs and component parts -- Vocabulary' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Shipbuilding Section'al Committee and approval of the Transport Engineering Division Council. This standard was first brought out in 1968 and subsequently revised in 1983. The present revision has been undertaken to harmonize it with current international practices. In this standard care has been taken to standardize only suitable terms and not to perpetuate unsuitable terms because of their use in the past. The illustrations

Scope

1 Domaine

d'application

the This International establishes Standard vocabulary for the various terms in use relative to the most important components of derrick rigs on ships. It lays down terms and definitions used in connection with derrick rigs, and adds terms for winches in accordance with ISO 3828. Where more than one term is given for a concept, the first term is the preferred one and others, although used within the marine industry, are non-preferred. Deprecated terms are also so indicated. A multilingual vocabula~ is given in annex A, arranged numerically in the order of the reference terms, in numbers; it provides a list of equivalent other languages, in the following orde~ ru: de: es: fi: it: Russian German Spanish Finnish Italian nl: no: pl: pt: Dutch Norwegian Polish Portuguese

La presente Norme irtternationale etablit Ie vocabulaire des different termes usuels pour Ies composants Ies plus important des matures a bord des navires. Elle donne Ies termes, ainsi que Ieurs definitions, utilises en rapport avec Ies m~turq,s, Ies termes relatifs aux treuils completes par conformes a 1'1S0 3828. Lorsque plusieurs termes sent concept, Ie premier terme est autres termes, bien qu'ils I'industrie maritime, ne sent termes qui sent tombes en indiques. donnes pour un m~me Ie terme prefere et Ies soient utilises clans pas souhaitables. Les desuetude sent aussi

Un vocabulaire multilingue est donne clans I'annexe A, classe clans I'ordre des numeros de reference; ii ne constitue qu'une Iiste de termes equivalents clans d'autres Iangues, donnees clans I'ordre suivanc nl: no: pl: pt: neerlandais norvegien polonais portugais

NOTE -- In addition to terms and definitions used in the three oftkial ISO languages (English, French and Russian), this International Standard gives the equivalent terms in German, Spanish, Finnish, Italian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish and Portuguese; these are published under the responsibility of the member bodies for Germany (DIN), Spain (AENOR), Finland (SFS), Italy (UNI), Netherlands (NNI), Norway (NSF), Poland (PKN) and Portugal (IPQ). However, only the terms and definitions given in the official languages can be considered as ISO terms and definitions.

001

derrick

Lifting gear device for hoisting and lowering loads having a derrick boom pivoted at its heel by a gooseneck bearing, the head of which may be swung in a horizontal and vertical plane. The derrick boom may be slewed into any position by means of span and guy tackle as desired. The operating machinery is fixed to the ship's structure and is independent of the derrick boom.

.
mat de charge Appareil de Ievage pour hisser ou affaler des charges, qui possede une come de charge articulee a son pied sur un support de vit de mulct; la t6te de cette come peut &re deplacee clans un plan horizontal ou vertical. La come de charge peut &re orient6e clans toute position desiree au moyen des palans d'apiquage et de brassage. Les appareils de manceuvre sent fix&s h la structure du navire et sent ind4pendants de la come de charge.

---- 002 light-load derrick Derrick with a derrick boom which may be slewed under load, the derrick rig permitting safe working loads up to approximately 15 t.

--

006

swinging derrick

Derrick rig in which a single derrick boom is used so that the suspended load is transferred from one point to another by swinging the derrick boom. -- Mature clans Iaquelle I'utilisation d'une seule come de charge permet de d6placer la charge suspendue d'un point A un autre par pivotement de cette come de charge.

come pivotante

007

union purchase

Derrick rig in which a pair of derrick booms is used in combination, the derrick booms being fixed by means of preventers and the cargo runners being coupled in such a way that the load may be swung from a position vertically under one derrick boom to a position vertically under the second.

Safe Working Load (SWL)

(1)

For the complete derrick rig, the maximum admissible load which may be applied to it. For a component, the maximum admissible load which may be applied to it. In the case of a single-sheaved block without a becket, the SWL is equal to half the maximum admissible load at the head fitting. In the case of a singlesheaved block with a becket, the SWL is equal to one-third the maximum admissible load at the head fitting.

NOTE --The SWL for the complete derrick rig is usually equal to the SWL of the cargo hook itself.

(2)

charge maximale d'utilisation (CMU)

(1)

(2)
